import pandas as pd
x = pd.ExcelFile("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx")
print(x.sheet_names)
for s in x.sheet_names:
    df = x.parse(s)
    print("==", s, df.shape)
    print(df.head(10))
    print(df.dtypes)
sets = {c: set(df[c].dropna().astype(str).str.strip()) - {"", "nan"} for c in df.columns}
for k,v in sets.items(): print(k, len(v))
from itertools import combinations
allids = set().union(*sets.values())
print("union", len(allids))
from collections import Counter
reg = Counter()
for i in allids:
    key = "".join(c for c in df.columns if i in sets[c])
    reg[key]+=1
print(len(reg))
print(sorted(reg.items(), key=lambda x:(-len(x[0]),-x[1]))[:40])
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(ggVennDiagram); library(ggplot2)
})
dat <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = 1)
sets <- lapply(dat, function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])
})
names(sets) <- colnames(dat)
print(sapply(sets, length))
cat("Union:", length(unique(unlist(sets))), "\n")
p <- ggVennDiagram(
       sets,
       label = "both",
       label_percent_digit = 1,
       label_alpha = 0,
       label_size = 2.6,
       set_size = 5,
       edge_size = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdYlBu", name = "Count") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.08)) +
    labs(title = "Proportional Venn diagram of 5 sets (A-E)",
         subtitle = "Each region: element count (percentage of the 243-element union)") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right")
ggsave("venn_5sets.png", p, width = 9, height = 7.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("venn_5sets.pdf", p, width = 9, height = 7.2, bg = "white")
cat("saved\n")
